messages:
ella (AE): Solstice wants a compact evidence bundle for the POC: SOC2 excerpts (encryption + access control), signed pen-test confirmation, staging IPs, and a presigned upload for their vuln-scan. Need to confirm timeline and cost.
diego (Sales-Eng): Do they want raw logs or just the attestation + excerpts?
ella (AE): They asked for logs to validate findings but said redactions are fine.
monica (Security): We can provide redacted logs + SOC2 control excerpts. I'll prepare a redaction checklist (remove customer IPs, tokens, user identifiers).
riley (Legal): Pen-test confirmation: we use our template. Need vendor name and completion date. No charge for standard attestation during POC.
ella (AE): Vendor: DeepProbe Labs. Completed 2025-04-02. No special notarization requested.
kevin (Infra): Staging IP blocks: 18.206.33.0/24 and 44.210.12.0/25. Presign TTL request?
diego (Sales-Eng): They asked for 72h presign to allow intake. Any objections?
kevin (Infra): 72h presign ok but ops wants it timeboxed; will create presign at send time. CLI sample: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/solstice.zip --expires-in 259200`.
monica (Security): Note: do not include admin console screenshots with session IDs. I'll scrub screenshots and logs.
riley (Legal): I can sign attestation by Thursday AM. Monica, confirm no open criticals at 2025-04-02 so we can include that statement.
monica (Security): Confirmed: no unresolved criticals as of 2025-04-02.
proof-bot: presign-task queued (id=7721). Owner: kevin. ETA: 2025-04-04 09:00 UTC.
kevin (Infra): Presign will be generated Friday 09:00 UTC with 72h expiry.
diego (Sales-Eng): I'll create a short README explaining redactions and contact for follow-ups in the proofpack.
ella (AE): Need to send before Friday EOD to keep POC timeline.
monica (Security): SOC2 excerpt + redaction checklist ready by Thursday EOD.
riley (Legal): Signed pen-test confirmation ready Friday morning.
kevin (Infra): Presign URL posted when ready.
ella (AE): I'll share with Solstice ops and close thread if no blockers. :thumbsup:
